findings.address_as_written: the passageway between Landmark Buildings B and C, Fort Mason Center
findings.description: An 18-panel public mural, 'The Sea Is But Another Sky,' was created in the passageway between Landmark Buildings B and C at Fort Mason Center, opening at the Fall Art Walk on September 17. The story is about the artwork and the event; it states no durable fact about the buildings themselves.

citation.label: The Voice of San Francisco, “Fort Mason Center turns historic loading docks into massive sunrise-to-moonrise mural,” 17 September 2026

raw.text: Created in the passageway between Landmark Buildings B and C at Fort Mason Center for Arts and Culture is a new 18-panel public mural

publish.note: Fails the ten-year test: an art installation hung in a passageway is an exhibit, not something that happened to the buildings. No numbered address either — Fort Mason's landmark buildings are named, not numbered, in the story.
